### 2026-10-09 – Developing the software :]

**6.88h**

Developing the software :]
October 9th. 2026

I started and hopefully finished developing the software... I decided to speak to Gemini and together paired with the already created Starbie.ino file on the Github, we created a  mutant with the alterations i wanted. For example, now button1 should open a menu and confirm the action and the button2 cycles thru the set actions. I decided to write the whole code by myself and tried checking it myself but i don't have a lot of expirience with this kind of thing... only a bit of java and python. As soon as my esp32 gets here ill test the code and hopefully itl work without any hitches along the way bet we all know how that goes... I also modified it so the program runs on the esp32 without any other componets without erroring. I'm excited to see how that goes. For the first 3 hours i learned how to work with the arduio software and studied how to add  the modificatioins with the github.
I first tryed debugging the code in the arduino software but since i don't have the esp32 yet it kept erroring...
i asked Gemini and it told me to go to wokwi simulator there i picked the esp32 and.... boom! It worked!  (after what felt like a eternity trying to debug it :/ )
I'm very happy it works now and next i think i will have to edit the PCB a bit and "make it a pretty pretty princes"
I now have a working build of the code and the PCB just needs a bit of editing which means... Ill hopefully progress onto week 2 of Half life :)

### 2026-10-09 – I looked for the components for the BOM

**2h**

I looked for the components for the BOM
9.10 2026

I started looking for the parts for my BOM... luckily i started now because if i started later who knows if id do it in time. I very quickly learned that shipping to Czechia SUCKS for example some international shiping was up to 1000,-czk but that's international thruout the EU its about 59-130,-czk which makes getting parts extreamly hard and Ill have to take some some things upon myself for example ill have to pay the esp32 C3 and the cherry mx switches out of my own pocket because the shipping is just highway robbery.
